title: The Rumored Hands
teaser: Chief Surgeon Emiko Mido sends word asking Sakaguchi to come by her office when free.

choices.choice_em0_table: "Whether they dare to step up to the table?"

nodes.em0_001:
Ryuji Sakaguchi receives word from Chief Surgeon Emiko Mido.
The message is brief.
"Drop by my office when you have a moment."
No reason is given.
nodes.em0_002:
Mido's office is even more immaculate than expected.
There are no personal photos on the desk, nor any spare ornaments.
Only a few operative notes, case summaries, and a cup of coffee gone completely cold.
nodes.em0_004:
She dispenses with pleasantries.
Barely has Ryuji Sakaguchi taken a seat before Mido lowers her eyes back to the file in her hand.
nodes.em0_008: "Assuming nobody secretly tampered with the copy in your hand."
nodes.em0_009:
Mido lifts her eyes.
She doesn't smile, though her gaze lingers a fraction longer than before.
nodes.em0_010: "A CV only proves someone managed not to make themselves look too pathetic on paper."
nodes.em0_011: "What a surgeon actually amounts to once they stand at the operating table—I prefer to see for myself."
nodes.em0_012: She brushes the CV aside, revealing a recently filed operative record from this hospital underneath.
nodes.em0_013: "People around the hospital say you operate well."
nodes.em0_015: "That's rumor. I wouldn't call someone in over a rumor."
nodes.em0_016: Her fingertip comes to rest on an intraoperative note halfway down the operative record.
nodes.em0_017: "This recent case you led. When you ran into localized oozing during deeper dissection, instead of pushing straight through with electrocautery, you stopped and re-established the margin from a clean tissue plane beside it."
nodes.em0_018: "Why? Cauterizing on the spot and pressing ahead would have saved at least five minutes."
nodes.em0_019: "The deep anatomical boundary wasn't fully exposed yet. Reaching straight for cautery just to save five minutes would only obscure the plane further with thermal injury and eschar."
nodes.em0_020: "Packing the ooze with gauze first and exposing the deep margin along the clean plane beside it looks slower, sure—but it spares you having to redo the work."
nodes.em0_021: Mido studies that line in the record for a beat, then looks back up at Sakaguchi. Her expression remains cool, devoid of polite praise.
nodes.em0_022: "You know when not to chase speed, and you didn't place clamps blindly when the plane wasn't clear."
nodes.em0_023: "On paper, at least, your head is reasonably clear."
nodes.em0_024: "Does that count as the Chief Surgeon's approval?"
nodes.em0_025: "An operative note is still just ink on paper."
nodes.em0_027:
Mido's gaze shifts away from Ryuji Sakaguchi's face.
It settles on his hands.
nodes.em0_029: "Do you always stare at another doctor's hands the first time you meet?"
nodes.em0_030: "When one surgeon meets another for the first time, if not their hands, where else would I look?"
nodes.em0_a_03: "At least, not most of the time."
nodes.em0_b_01: "I already told you—I don't put faith in those."
nodes.em0_c_01: "Plenty of people dare to step up to the table."
nodes.em0_c_02: "Far fewer know when to keep their hands still."
nodes.em0_032: "When a suitable case comes up, I'll call you into my operating room."
nodes.em0_033: "I'll lead. You'll scrub in as first assistant."
nodes.em0_037: "Then I'll know the rumors weren't worth my time."
nodes.em0_038: She picks up the chart folder from her desk again, her eyes already returning to the page—plainly considering the meeting over.
nodes.em0_039: "Once we're at the operating table, I'll see for myself."
nodes.em0_040: "Whether those rumored hands are actually worth remembering."
